- phase goal: 3-band split, APF cascades, envelope follower, dynamic low boost; all audio state pre-allocated in prepareToPlay

Header requirements:
- Declare class SonicMaximizer (or equivalent name matching project style) with publicly callable prepare(double sampleRate, int samplesPerBlock) and process(...) suitable for real-time use from the audio thread

  - Cached APF coefficient a and contour parameter storage (LoContour); coefficients/constants updated only in prepare or on parameter change helpers, never implied as per-sample raw param math in the header contract
- Document in comments near process that process must perform: no new/delete/resize, no locks, no juce::String work; use ScopedNoDenormals at call site or inside process as appropriate
- Include only necessary JUCE DSP headers; keep the type complete for a later .cpp implementation
- Provide clear member names for band filters, APF arrays, envelope, sampleRate cache, and parameter targets

Do not implement DSP math in this task; declarations and state layout only.
